meta.title: House & Business Budget Planner
meta.description: Multi-house cash flow and budgeting application with synchronized income/expense tables, label-to-account mapping, monthly timeline, and interactive cash flow chart.

common.name: Name
common.label: Label
common.reorderOnlyDefaultSort: Order can be changed only with the default ascending date sort

auth.signInLead: Sign in to see your houses and shared budgets.
auth.signUpLead: Create an account. You can then create houses and share them with others.
auth.passwordHintNamed: Leave the password blank if you only want to change your name.
auth.passwordHintGoogle: Password is optional if you sign in with Google.
auth.needCurrentPassword: Enter your current password to change it.
auth.passwordsDoNotMatch: The new passwords do not match.
auth.welcomeLead: You signed in from an invite. Set your name, email, and password so you can sign in next time.
auth.inviteLead: You were invited to create an account. This invite does not grant access to any house — you can create one later, or receive a separate sharing invite.
auth.signedInAs: You are signed in as {name}. This invite creates a new account, so sign out first.

houses.fallbackDescription: Manage budgets, accounts, and synchronized cash flow
houses.addHouseLead: Create a new house (e.g. Home, Company, Rental...).
houses.emptyLead: Create your own house. It will belong to you and you can share it later.
houses.settingsLead: Rename the house, manage sharing, or delete it.
houses.sharingLead: A shared user can edit the budget, but cannot delete the house or change sharing.
houses.inviteLinkHelp: A new user who opens the link is signed in automatically and sets their own password.
houses.noMatches: Nobody found. Try a different query, or send the invite link.
houses.pickUserOrEmail: Pick a user from the list, or enter an email.
houses.copyFailedManual: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
houses.pendingAccountSetup: Waiting to set up the account
houses.notSharedYet: You are not sharing this house with anyone yet.
houses.confirmDeleteHouse: Do you really want to delete the house "{name}"?

accounts.title: Bank accounts and labels
accounts.info: An account has only a name, color, and visibility. Labels belong to an account. An account hidden from overview still appears in the plan; an account hidden everywhere is for virtual transactions.
accounts.confirmDeleteAccount: Do you really want to remove the account "{name}"? Labels on this account will be deleted and items will move to the default account.
accounts.accountModalLead: An account has a name, color, and visibility level.
accounts.confirmDeleteLabel: Do you really want to delete the label "{name}"?
accounts.labelModalLead: A label always belongs to an account. Items with this label take that account.
accounts.pickAccountDirectly: Without a label you can pick the account directly
accounts.visibilityEverywhereDesc: Counts toward overview, charts, and the plan.
accounts.visibilityExceptDashboardDesc: Stays in the plan and catalog, but does not enter the dashboard or charts.
accounts.visibilityNowhereDesc: Virtual / untracked transactions, outside every overview.

catalog.title: Expenses and income
catalog.tableCount: {count, plural, one {# table} few {# tables} other {# tables}}
catalog.noSavedTablesLead: On the Expenses and income tab, set filters and sorting and save the view. Saved tables are visible to every house member.
catalog.info: Monthly items repeat every month in the plan and use a date like 15.*. Annual expenses are placed only in that month and use a date like 15.3.
catalog.emptyFilter: No items for the selected filter.
catalog.monthlyWithYearly: Monthly expenses including 1/12 of annual expenses:
catalog.monthlyWithYearlyTitle: Annual expenses counted as 1/12 of the amount
catalog.expenseIncomeRatio: Share of monthly expenses to income:
catalog.expenseIncomeRatioTitle: Monthly expenses including 1/12 of annual expenses / monthly income
catalog.expenseAmountHint: A positive amount is an expense, a negative amount is a refund

plan.title: Budget plan: {month} {year}
plan.info: Items come from the income and expense tables. For this month you can override values or add one-off items. The running balance in a row always belongs to the assigned account.
plan.emptyFilter: No items in the plan for the selected filter.
plan.balanceAlwaysChronological: Balance is always chronological by day, independent of the current sort
plan.restoreSync: Restore sync — revert to catalog values
plan.amountHint: A positive amount is income, a negative amount is an expense

cashflow.actualAfterToday: Actual status after today's payments are settled
cashflow.monthInfo: Liquidity over the month, with today and planned transactions marked. Hide accounts in the legend — that also affects the summary above the chart.
cashflow.yearInfo: Liquidity over the calendar year. Hide accounts in the legend — that also affects the summary above the chart.

users.title: Users
users.lead: An invite creates a new account without access to your houses. The invited person sets their own password and starts with no house. To share a specific house, use the invite link in house settings.
users.inviteLinkHelp: This link does not share a house. The invited person only creates an account.
